authority.note: DESIGN SNIPED from the christofuturism universe's `christofuturist-spatial-lenses` at Gary's direction 2026-08-11 ("directly snipe the holographic glasses from here"), while standing up the pcs.wiki device canon. The design is carried over exactly: clear champagne acetate, old-gold inlay, smoke-gold tint, eyes always visible. The PLATES are not: the source hero is photoreal, and `photoreal` is an explicit rejected pole of this universe, so a copied master would have fought the register on every render that passed it. New masters were shot in warm-editorial ink-and-wash and the source plates are kept under `lineage/` as the design record, never as render references. See the derived-from relation. SUPERSEDED 2026-08-12: this device moved to its own universe at ~/Documents/github-repos/pcs-universe with a photoreal register and a pearl body material. Do not render from this entity for pcs work; it is kept because already-shipped history keeps rendering. See the derived-from relation in the pcs universe.

render.always: THE SPATIAL LENSES: ordinary-looking eyeglasses in a clear translucent champagne acetate frame with a slim old-gold inlay running along the temples and brow, in an elegant modern wayfarer shape. The lenses carry only a faint smoke-gold tint, so the wearer's eyes are ALWAYS visible through them. They are eyeglasses, never goggles, never a visor, never a headset, never opaque sunglasses, and never black frames. No logo, no brand mark, no lettering anywhere. Warm-editorial ink-and-wash, never photoreal, never neon.

scale.size: ordinary adult eyeglasses, about 140 mm across the front; read as normal glasses at conversational distance and as a warm champagne glint at room distance

prose.lore: The wearable form of the guardian angel: the way a person sees what their machine is doing without stopping to look at a screen. The design intent is that it reads as eyewear a person would already have chosen, so wearing one is not an announcement. When the system is working the frame carries a faint warm glow along the gold inlay, never a projected panel and never a screen the viewer can read.
prose.rules: The lenses are UNBRANDED and unremarkable at a glance: their whole argument is that a person is glad to be seen in them. Never render them as goggles, a visor, a headset, or opaque sunglasses; the eyes are always visible, because a device that hides the wearer's eyes defeats the point. Any 'smart' behavior is shown ONLY as a faint warm glow along the old-gold inlay, never as a floating HUD, never as readable text or panels in the air, never as a lit screen. No buttons, no antennas, no cameras, no LEDs are ever added. COMPOSITION RULE inherited from the source design: when a figure holds or receives the glowing lenses in their hands, position the hands LOW at waist level or off to one side, never cupped and glowing at the chest.
